title: Works…some of the time.
text:
I’ve been paying for Mathway for over a year now, and when it actually works, it does what I need it to do. The problem is that reliability is hit or miss. Too often I find myself having to log back in multiple times in a single session, or rebooting the app just to keep it running. That kind of interruption defeats the purpose of a paying for a tool that’s supposed to make problem solving quick and simple. 
It’s frustrating because Mathway used to be clean and dependable, but in the past few months it feels weighed down by login prompts and bugs. When it functions properly, it’s a good tool. But for a subscription service, “some of the time” shouldn’t be the standard.
